name: amfx-housing-gdp-share-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p3): Housing Share of GDP showing Residential Fixed Investment and Housing Services as stacked components. Total housing ~16-18% of GDP. Residential Fixed Investment from A011RE1Q156NBEA (direct % share), Housing Services computed as DHUTRC1Q027SBEA / GDP * 100. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets (original: BEA data).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: HOUSING SHARE OF GDP (25OCT22 p3)
# =============================================================================
# Stacked area chart showing housing's true footprint: ~16-18% of GDP.
# Blue: Residential Fixed Investment (~3-6%)
# Red: Housing & Utilities Services (~12-13%)
# =============================================================================

# Residential Fixed Investment as share of GDP (quarterly, direct %)
rfi_share_src = economic_indicators(series_id='A011RE1Q156NBEA')()
rfi_share = ffill(rfi_share_src.result)

# Housing & Utilities Services (quarterly, nominal billions SAAR)
housing_svc_src = economic_indicators(series_id='DHUTRC1Q027SBEA')()
housing_svc = ffill(housing_svc_src.result)

# Nominal GDP (quarterly, billions SAAR)
gdp_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GDP')()
gdp = ffill(gdp_src.result)

# Compute housing services as % of GDP
housing_svc_share = housing_svc / gdp * 100.0

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Housing Is 16-18% of GDP: Larger Than Most People Realize',
    category='Housing GDP Share',
    y_axis_label='% of GDP',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Residential Fixed Investment', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Housing & Utilities Services', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, rfi_share, housing_svc_share)
